You are doing the final polish for CROBOT (ConvertScan) — writing the project CLAUDE.md and deployment config.

**Project path**: /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/CROBOT

## Task 1: Write CLAUDE.md

Read the existing (empty) CLAUDE.md at the project root, then write comprehensive project instructions:

```markdown
# ConvertScan (CROBOT)

AI-powered CRO (Conversion Rate Optimization) audit tool. Users paste a URL and get instant, scored analysis with specific AI-generated suggestions to boost conversions.

## Stack
- **Frontend**: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui
- **Backend**: Supabase (Auth + PostgreSQL + Edge Functions + Storage)
- **AI**: Claude API (claude-sonnet-4-20250514) for Vision + Text analysis
- **Billing**: Stripe (subscriptions)
- **Email**: Resend
- **Performance**: Google PageSpeed Insights API
- **Screenshots**: Puppeteer service on Railway

## Architecture
- SPA (Vite) — no SSR. All backend logic in Supabase Edge Functions (Deno runtime)
- Auth: Supabase Auth (Google OAuth + email/password)
- Database: PostgreSQL via Supabase with RLS on every table
- Storage: Supabase Storage for screenshots
- Edge Functions: Deno runtime, import from URLs (not npm)

## Key Files
- `src/App.tsx` — routing, AuthProvider wrapping
- `src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx` — auth state management
- `src/pages/Scan.tsx` — core scan submission flow
- `src/pages/AuditReport.tsx` — report display with 7 CRO pillars
- `src/pages/Dashboard.tsx` — KPI cards, recent scans, charts
- `src/hooks/use-scans.ts` — all scan CRUD operations
- `src/hooks/use-scan-results.ts` — pillar results queries
- `src/hooks/use-billing.ts` — Stripe checkout/portal
- `src/lib/pdf-generator.ts` — client-side PDF generation
- `src/lib/supabase.ts` — Supabase client
- `src/lib/constants.ts` — CRO pillars, weights, plan limits
- `src/lib/score-utils.ts` — scoring algorithm, color mapping
- `src/types/index.ts` — all TypeScript types
- `src/types/database.ts` — Supabase database types
- `supabase/functions/analyze-url/` — main scan orchestrator
- `supabase/functions/analyze-url/prompts.ts` — AI system prompts
- `supabase/functions/analyze-url/scoring.ts` — scoring engine
- `supabase/functions/pagespeed/` — Google PageSpeed integration
- `supabase/functions/stripe-checkout/` — Stripe checkout session
- `supabase/functions/stripe-webhook/` — Stripe event handler
- `supabase/functions/send-email/` — Resend email service

## Database Tables
- `profiles` — user profiles with plan/billing info
- `scans` — audit scan records
- `scan_results` — per-pillar results with findings JSONB
- `integrations` — third-party service connections

## The 7 CRO Pillars
1. Value Proposition (18% weight)
2. CTA Effectiveness (20% weight)
3. Trust Signals (17% weight)
4. Visual Hierarchy (12% weight)
5. Mobile Experience (13% weight)
6. Content & Copy (11% weight)
7. Page Performance (9% weight)

## Pricing Tiers
- Free: 3 scans/month, basic score, top 3 suggestions
- Pro ($49/mo): 25 scans, all suggestions, AI rewrites, PDF, monitoring
- Agency ($199/mo): 500 scans, white-label, multi-client, API

## Commands
- `npm run dev` — start dev server (port 8080)
- `npm run build` — production build
- `npm run lint` — ESLint
- `npx supabase functions serve` — local edge functions

## Environment Variables
### Frontend (.env.local)
- VITE_SUPABASE_URL
- VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
- VITE_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY

### Supabase Edge Functions (secrets)
- ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
- PAGESPEED_API_KEY
- SCREENSHOT_SERVICE_URL
- SCREENSHOT_SERVICE_API_KEY
- STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
- STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
- STRIPE_PRICE_PRO_MONTHLY / ANNUAL
- STRIPE_PRICE_AGENCY_MONTHLY / ANNUAL
- RESEND_API_KEY
- SITE_URL

## Conventions
- All components use shadcn/ui from `@/components/ui/`
- Toast notifications via `sonner`
- React Query for all server state
- Supabase RLS enforces data isolation — no manual auth checks needed in queries
- Edge functions return JSON with CORS headers
- Findings stored as JSONB arrays in scan_results
- Score colors: green (70+), amber (40-69), red (0-39)
```

# ConvertScan (CROBOT)

AI-powered CRO (Conversion Rate Optimization) audit tool. Users paste a URL and get instant, scored analysis with specific AI-generated suggestions to boost conversions.

## Stack
- **Frontend**: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui
- **Backend**: Supabase (Auth + PostgreSQL + Edge Functions + Storage)
- **AI**: Claude API (claude-sonnet-4-20250514) for Vision + Text analysis
- **Billing**: Stripe (subscriptions)
- **Email**: Resend
- **Performance**: Google PageSpeed Insights API
- **Screenshots**: Puppeteer service on Railway

## Architecture
- SPA (Vite) — no SSR. All backend logic in Supabase Edge Functions (Deno runtime)
- Auth: Supabase Auth (Google OAuth + email/password)
- Database: PostgreSQL via Supabase with RLS on every table
- Storage: Supabase Storage for screenshots
- Edge Functions: Deno runtime, import from URLs (not npm)

## Key Files
- `src/App.tsx` — routing, AuthProvider wrapping
- `src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx` — auth state management
- `src/pages/Scan.tsx` — core scan submission flow
- `src/pages/AuditReport.tsx` — report display with 7 CRO pillars
- `src/pages/Dashboard.tsx` — KPI cards, recent scans, charts
- `src/hooks/use-scans.ts` — all scan CRUD operations
- `src/hooks/use-scan-results.ts` — pillar results queries
- `src/hooks/use-billing.ts` — Stripe checkout/portal
- `src/lib/pdf-generator.ts` — client-side PDF generation
- `src/lib/supabase.ts` — Supabase client
- `src/lib/constants.ts` — CRO pillars, weights, plan limits
- `src/lib/score-utils.ts` — scoring algorithm, color mapping
- `src/types/index.ts` — all TypeScript types
- `src/types/database.ts` — Supabase database types
- `supabase/functions/analyze-url/` — main scan orchestrator
- `supabase/functions/analyze-url/prompts.ts` — AI system prompts
- `supabase/functions/analyze-url/scoring.ts` — scoring engine
- `supabase/functions/pagespeed/` — Google PageSpeed integration
- `supabase/functions/stripe-checkout/` — Stripe checkout session
- `supabase/functions/stripe-webhook/` — Stripe event handler
- `supabase/functions/send-email/` — Resend email service

## Database Tables
- `profiles` — user profiles with plan/billing info
- `scans` — audit scan records
- `scan_results` — per-pillar results with findings JSONB
- `integrations` — third-party service connections

## The 7 CRO Pillars
1. Value Proposition (18% weight)
2. CTA Effectiveness (20% weight)
3. Trust Signals (17% weight)
